**Fixture hygiene mechanism (#842)**

testTmp(prefix) routes every fixture under one per-run brain-test-<pid> root removed by a single exit hook; pretest sweeps roots with dead pids (SIGKILL defense). Measured leakers: pm-iso 2180/green-run, 6686 orphans/11G total ENOSPC; production leaked too (promote D3 proof dir, probeBase worktree, cold-boot review checkout 464M). Cleanup is structural, not disciplined.
